cards.label: Policy Dialogue
cards.description: Structured conversations that move from diagnosis to decision, bringing ministries, donors and implementers around a shared evidence base.

cards.label: Executive Roundtables
cards.description: High-level gatherings for strategic alignment among decision-makers, designed to produce concrete commitments and next steps.

cards.label: Investment Forums
cards.description: Curated events connecting capital to pipelines, matching institutional investors with investment-ready projects across sectors.

cards.label: Technical Working Groups
cards.description: Deep-dive sessions on specific challenges, producing technical outputs that inform policy and implementation decisions.

cards.label: Research–Policy Translation
cards.description: Bridging evidence and decision-making through structured processes that convert research findings into actionable policy options.

cards.label: Stakeholder Consultations
cards.description: Inclusive processes for legitimacy and uptake, ensuring reforms reflect the needs and perspectives of affected communities.

cards.label: Consensus-Building Processes
cards.description: Facilitating agreement across diverse interests, from multi-stakeholder negotiations to inter-ministerial coordination.
